services.name: Freedom Martial Arts
services.desc: My 3 and 4 year-old boys are in the Lil Dragons program. They both absolutely love it. The instructors are so good and so patient with the young kids. I highly recommend FMA! My son has been attending Freedom Martial Arts for 3 and a half years now and he loves it. My son was very shy, struggled with social anxiety, and he would have a meltdown in a large crowd when we first started attending classes here. For the longest time, the instructors didn’t even know he could talk. Master Altizer and his team helped my son become confident and helped him open up.
